title: Craftable Enchanted Golden Apple
description: Add a recipe to craft notch apples.
body:
Adds a somewhat balanced recipe to craft enchanted golden apples. Extremely simple, thus conflicts are not to be of consideration.

The Recipe:

    
  ```
  IGI
  BAB
  IGI
  ```


Where, I = Gold Ingot
       B = Bottle of Enchanting
       A = Apple
       G = Gold Block
